head: NO REPLY TO
YOUR <g>JOB</g>
APPLICATION?
hacks: Recruiters are busy and chasing too early can seem pushy.
Add five working days to their target date before emailing.
It keeps your context and application history right in front of them.
Hit reply on your previous application or interview email.
A concise message is easy to read and answer on a busy day.
Write two lines stating your interest and asking for an update.
A quick reminder helps them remember why you reached this stage.
Mention one clear reason you remain keen on the role.
A polite signoff takes pressure off while prompting a response.
End with: "I look forward to hearing from you when convenient."
out: Send it to a friend waiting
